data.summary: The pod startup was delayed primarily by the app_init phase, which took 34.4 seconds. Within this phase, the init.compute task accounted for 31.3 seconds of processing time. Given the low CPU limit of 250m, this compute-intensive initialisation is likely being throttled.

findings.statement: The app_init phase took 34.362 s, which represents the majority of the 39.0 s total startup time.
The init.compute span was the slowest component of the initialisation, lasting 31.299 s.
The container is restricted by a low CPU limit of 250m, which likely throttles the compute-heavy startup task.

ruled_out.reason: The image pull took only 4.228 s for 53 MB, indicating normal pull performance.
Scheduling duration was 0.0 s, showing no issues with node capacity or scheduling.
Readiness probe duration was 0.0 s, meaning the application was ready immediately after app_init completed.

recommendations.action: Increase the CPU limit for the container.
recommendations.rationale: The current 250m limit is likely causing CPU throttling during the compute-intensive init.compute phase.
Reducing the number of work units or improving the efficiency of the initialisation code will directly reduce startup time.
